description: Type definitions and data models for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) Ingest API, including configuration options for chunking, OCR, embeddings, vector stores (OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI), and API request/response schemas.

classes.name: RAGChunkingStrategy
classes.description: Configuration for chunking strategy in RAG ingest, including chunk size, overlap, and separators.

classes.name: RAGIngestOCROptions
classes.description: Configuration for OCR options in RAG ingest pipeline.

classes.name: RAGIngestEmbeddingOptions
classes.description: Configuration for embedding model options in RAG ingest pipeline.

classes.name: OpenAIVectorStoreOptions
classes.description: Configuration for OpenAI vector store, including provider, ID, credentials, and TTL.

classes.name: BedrockVectorStoreOptions
classes.description: Configuration for Bedrock knowledge base, including resource IDs, credentials, and AWS settings.

classes.name: VertexAIVectorStoreOptions
classes.description: Configuration for Vertex AI RAG engine, including GCP project, location, credentials, and GCS bucket.

classes.name: RAGIngestOptions
classes.description: Unified configuration for RAG ingest pipeline, combining OCR, chunking, embedding, and vector store options.

classes.name: RAGIngestResponse
classes.description: Schema for response from RAG ingest API, including status, IDs, and error info.

classes.name: RAGIngestRequest
classes.description: Schema for request body to RAG ingest API, including file info and ingest options.

classes.name: RAGRetrievalConfig
classes.description: Configuration for vector store retrieval, including store ID, provider, top_k, and filters.

classes.name: RAGRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration for reranking results, including enabled flag, model, top_n, and document return.

classes.name: RAGQueryRequest
classes.description: Request schema for RAG query API, including model, messages, retrieval config, rerank, and stream options.

classes.name: RAGQueryResponse
classes.description: Response schema for RAG query API, inheriting from ModelResponse.
